values.note: 2026 RV rates: Freeport residents $17 inland, $18 waterfront; non-residents $52 inland, $58 waterfront (the non-resident premium is $35 inland, $40 waterfront). Plus 9% sales tax. Covers 2 adults and 1 shelter. Non-residents have no cheaper site than $52.

Reservations from April 1, online only until early May, and at least 2 business days ahead. A Saturday stay needs a second night (Friday or Sunday); 1 night is fine Monday-Thursday outside holidays. Reservations non-refundable. The 14-night cap is sites 1-23 in July and August; the brochure says reservations are limited to 14.
2026 dates. Generally Memorial Day weekend through the last weekend of September.

season.source: https://me-freeport.civicplus.com/Faq.aspx?QID=601 ('The camping season runs from Friday May 22nd through Monday September 28th') + https://www.freeportmaine.com/DocumentCenter/View/486/Park-Map--Brochure-PDF, read 2026-11-02

summary: Fees changed from a mixed 17-58 to base $17-18 (Freeport residents) with +$35 non-resident premium; $52-58 is what non-residents pay. Added booking rules, 2026 season, no hookups, 100 sites, dump, showers. --AWH note kept.
flags: FEES: schema says the base is the resident price, so I wrote $17-18 with the non-resident premium, but 'resident' here is Freeport residents only; any visitor pays $52 inland, $58 waterfront. A non-resident premium of one figure can't carry both ($35 inland, $40 waterfront), so the note spells it out. For a family outside Freeport the $52 is over the US$50 gate if that gate is applied to a town park, with Freeport/Casco Bay not checked against the gateway list.
PHONE: entry has none. Town gives park manager 207-865-4743 ext. 126. The brochure says x127 for reservations/fees. apply.py doesn't write phone.

WATERFRONT: bayfront rests on the --AWH note, so not disputed. The brochure map shows sites 1-23 along the Casco Bay side with a 'Scenic Trail' between them and the shore, and the town itself prices 'Waterfront' sites. Imagery was cloud-covered over that stretch, so the frontage is unconfirmed by me either way.

PIN: stored point sits on the entry road where it reaches the bay point. The brochure puts the numbered sites beyond it, running out the peninsula, and imagery over them is cloud, so I can't give corrected coordinates. Worth re-viewing on clear imagery; the centroid may be more than 250 m NE.
UNREAD: thinkreservations shows no 2027 inventory, so per-site lengths and rig limits weren't read. The brochure says 'RV and/or tents appropriate to family and lot size', no length figure.
UNCLEAR: 'Rest Room' on the map doesn't say flush, and drinking water isn't stated on what I read, so neither was written.
